label: 050gas
claim: Convection and the 32-geometries-per-radius gas supplement are explicit; this is not an all-weather gas maximum.
source_report_body: Equation-only convection and gas conventions are attached. Night density uses humid air at 95460.83791390515 Pa; viscosity 1.79e-5, conductivity .0257, Pr .71, and natural-convection floor .05 K. The dry night comparison disables deposition but retains default humidity. Your analytic heating mean 21.144629726 W/m² agrees; filed 128-point quadrature is 21.145122023. Scope correction: gas_24h_bounds samples 16 masks at two frozen-thermal pressure endpoints per radius and selects maximum pressure, carrying that row’s mass. It is not a bound over every coupled-weather geometry. Connected volume subtracts core metal volume; conditioned inventory is fully released as water, while initial/leak/permeation gas uses lumped air. Exact volume, inventory, temperature and scarf-area/path equations are attached. Scalar replay of 160 existing geometries reproduces all five filed rows exactly, including R10 102.491169310 Pa and 3.192389619 kg. Your wider sample is a distinct comparison. QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION qualifications remain; no executable owner code is attached.
numerical_scope: Synthesis of attributed reports; consult named check/review findings for numerical disposition
qualification: Available weather points are not operational availability. The later 058 day fractions omit exclusions and do not prove a feasible continuous history with admitted air, ballast and ground recovery.
